finding: At the pinned source, AdminUtils.getOpenTransactionsForTopics does not issue an unfiltered single lookup. It calls Admin.listTransactions with ListTransactionsOptions filtered to producer IDs obtained from getProducerIds(admin, topicNames) and to TransactionState.ONGOING. Resolving those producer IDs itself traverses getProducerStates -> getTopicPartitions -> getTopicMetadata, invoking Admin.describeTopics(topicNames) and Admin.describeProducers(topicPartitions) before listTransactions. The method catches exceptions, re-interrupts on InterruptedException, and throws RuntimeException with a diagnostic that mentions Kafka broker version >=3.0 and read permissions on target topics.
falsifying_trace: Input topicNames -> describeTopics(topicNames) -> derived topic partitions -> describeProducers(partitions) -> active producer IDs -> listTransactions(filterProducerIds(ids), filterStates(ONGOING)) -> all().get(); any exception in this chain is converted to RuntimeException after interrupt preservation.
failure_relevance: For this exact pinned utility path, apparent 'open transactions for topics' reconstruction depends on live Kafka Admin execution and topic-read authority across multiple admin calls; it is therefore not a self-contained scheduled-Chat/state-only parity mechanism. The source also exposes broker-version/permission failure conditions in its own diagnostic path.
